root_cause.text: The hid-appletb-kbd autodim logic wrongly called backlight_device_set_brightness() from atomic IRQ/softirq contexts (the timer callback and input-event reset path), even though that backlight path takes backlight_device->ops_lock via mutex_lock() and may sleep.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE/commit explicitly says both appletb_inactivity_timer() (a struct timer_list callback in softirq context) and reset_inactivity_timer() (invoked from HID/input event paths running in IRQ/softirq context) triggered “BUG: sleeping function called from invalid context” through backlight_device_set_brightness() -> mutex_lock(), and the patch fixes this by replacing the timer with delayed_work and scheduling separate restore_brightness_work so the calls run in process context.

intent_record.intent_summary: Replace the timer header with the workqueue header so the file includes the kernel API it actually uses.
intent_record.what: The code replaces the header include `#include <linux/timer.h>` with `#include <linux/workqueue.h>` in the file's include list.
intent_record.how: At build time, this switches the available kernel API declarations from timer-related interfaces to workqueue-related interfaces, allowing the file to use workqueue constructs instead of timer constructs and avoiding reliance on an unrelated header.

intent_record.intent_summary: Replace the keyboard driver's inactivity timer with workqueue-based delayed and immediate work items for backlight inactivity and brightness restoration handling.
intent_record.what: In struct appletb_kbd, the field `struct timer_list inactivity_timer` was removed and replaced with two workqueue-based fields: `struct delayed_work inactivity_work` and `struct work_struct restore_brightness_work`.
intent_record.how: This changes the driver's deferred-execution mechanism from a single timer callback to workqueue-managed jobs, allowing inactivity handling to be scheduled as delayed work and brightness restoration to run as a separate work item in process context rather than timer context.

intent_record.intent_summary: Convert the Touch Bar inactivity callback from a timer handler to delayed work while preserving the dimming and shutdown behavior.
intent_record.what: The callback function was changed from a timer callback `appletb_inactivity_timer(struct timer_list *t)` to a workqueue callback `appletb_inactivity_work(struct work_struct *work)`. The retrieval of the parent `struct appletb_kbd` was updated from `timer_container_of(..., inactivity_timer)` to `container_of(to_delayed_work(work), struct appletb_kbd, inactivity_work)`. Inside the dimming path, the rescheduling call was changed from `mod_timer(&kbd->inactivity_timer, jiffies + secs_to_jiffies(appletb_tb_idle_timeout))` to `mod_delayed_work(system_wq, &kbd->inactivity_work, secs_to_jiffies(appletb_tb_idle_timeout))`.
intent_record.how: This changes the inactivity handling from executing in timer context to executing as delayed work on the system workqueue. At runtime, the dimming and shutoff logic still runs after the idle timeout, but now it runs in process context and is rescheduled through delayed work instead of a timer, which enables the same behavior through a workqueue-based mechanism and avoids timer-callback execution context constraints.

intent_record.intent_summary: Move Touch Bar brightness restoration and inactivity rescheduling into workqueue context to safely restore brightness after dimming or shutdown.
intent_record.what: A new workqueue callback function, appletb_restore_brightness_work(), was added to recover the keyboard backlight brightness by calling backlight_device_set_brightness(kbd->backlight_dev, 2) when a backlight device exists. In reset_inactivity_timer(), the direct brightness restore call was removed, the dimmed/off state flags are still cleared, brightness restoration is now deferred via schedule_work(&kbd->restore_brightness_work), and the timeout rescheduling changed from mod_timer(&kbd->inactivity_timer, jiffies + secs_to_jiffies(appletb_tb_dim_timeout)) to mod_delayed_work(system_wq, &kbd->inactivity_work, secs_to_jiffies(appletb_tb_dim_timeout)).
intent_record.how: Instead of restoring brightness immediately inside reset_inactivity_timer(), the code now performs that operation asynchronously in workqueue context, which avoids doing the backlight update directly at the reset point and aligns the inactivity timeout rescheduling with delayed work rather than a timer. At runtime this causes brightness recovery after dim/off state to be handled in process context, helping prevent issues that can arise from invoking backlight operations from timer-related paths while preserving the behavior of re-enabling brightness and restarting inactivity handling.

intent_record.intent_summary: Replace timer-based keyboard backlight inactivity handling with delayed work and restore work so brightness management runs safely in workqueue context.
intent_record.what: The code removes initialization and scheduling of `kbd->inactivity_timer` using `timer_setup()` and `mod_timer()`, and replaces it with initialization of `kbd->inactivity_work` via `INIT_DELAYED_WORK()`, initialization of `kbd->restore_brightness_work` via `INIT_WORK()`, and scheduling of the delayed work with `mod_delayed_work(system_wq, &kbd->inactivity_work, secs_to_jiffies(appletb_tb_dim_timeout))`.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the keyboard backlight inactivity handling is changed from a timer-based callback mechanism to workqueue-based deferred execution, and it also adds a separate work item for restoring brightness. This enables the inactivity dimming and brightness restoration logic to run in process context instead of timer context, which is safer for operations that may sleep or require workqueue semantics.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix probe failure cleanup by synchronously cancelling pending backlight work before releasing the backlight device.
intent_record.what: In the error cleanup path of appletb_kbd_probe(), the code replaces timer_delete_sync(&kbd->inactivity_timer) with cancel_delayed_work_sync(&kbd->inactivity_work) and adds cancel_work_sync(&kbd->restore_brightness_work) before put_device(&kbd->backlight_dev->dev).
intent_record.how: At runtime, probe failure cleanup now synchronously cancels the keyboard backlight inactivity delayed work and the restore brightness work instead of deleting a timer, preventing pending work items from running after the device teardown and avoiding use-after-free or invalid backlight device access during cleanup.

intent_record.intent_summary: Cancel pending keyboard backlight work items during device removal to avoid work running after teardown.
intent_record.what: In appletb_kbd_remove(), the call to timer_delete_sync(&kbd->inactivity_timer) inside the backlight_dev cleanup block was removed and replaced with cancel_delayed_work_sync(&kbd->inactivity_work) and cancel_work_sync(&kbd->restore_brightness_work) before put_device(&kbd->backlight_dev->dev).
intent_record.how: At device removal time, the driver now synchronously cancels both the delayed inactivity work and the restore brightness work instead of deleting a timer, preventing pending or running workqueue callbacks from accessing backlight-related state after the device is being torn down.

This group directly replaces the timer-based inactivity/autodim handling with workqueue/delayed work, moving the brightness-setting paths into sleepable process context and thus addressing the vulnerability.

The changes directly move backlight brightness/inactivity handling out of timer/input atomic contexts into workqueue context, preventing calls to backlight_device_set_brightness() from paths that may sleep. The added cancellation during probe failure/removal also supports safe teardown of the new deferred work.
